operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm run verify && pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm check:deployment-spec
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md and RUN-LOCALLY.md: pause writes and scheduled work, retain the exact source and private configuration, run rer export, restore with rer import into fresh empty D1 and R2 resources, and re-export to compare records and file bytes. Require fresh native owner sign-in before routing traffic. Preserve all applied migration names and bytes.
